trainable_domain: native LoRA-B only on GPT-2 layers 10 and 11; rank 2; frozen backbone and LoRA-A
candidate_generation: seeded isotropic Gaussian directions projected into the current response kernel
prompt_partition: selection, branch-training and final-evaluation templates are pairwise disjoint
unit_of_inference: seed; two nodes averaged within each seed
claim_boundary: Prospective paired intervention in a finite artificial GPT-2 rank-2 native-LoRA-B task. A positive result supports a causal difference in short-horizon held-out learning between response-matched states selected by frozen local capacity; it does not revise PC1-PC3, establish natural AdamW navigation, full-model representation theory, semantic learning, generalization, or a universal law of intelligence.
